crash_root_cause.explanation: The checkpoint model_config does NOT store input_size. validate_transformer_config() uses TransformerModelConfig defaults: input_size=31 (FS1_TF1). But Phase46 uses FS2_TF1 with 33 features. Model built with input_projection=[64,31]; checkpoint weights are [64,33] -> RuntimeError at load_state_dict.

missing_features.detail: NOT 2 missing features — this is a dimension mismatch. Checkpoint weights have 33 features; model was built for 31.

CRITICAL.root_cause: validate_transformer_config(model_config) filters model_config dict. TransformerModelConfig defaults input_size=31 (FS1_TF1). Phase46 uses FS2_TF1=33. Model built [64,31]; weights are [64,33] -> RuntimeError.
CRITICAL.impact: RuntimeError at load_state_dict. All 3 seeds crash at first inference.

CRITICAL.root_cause: feature_registry_path = ROOT / 'artifacts' / 'features' / 'feature_set_registry.json'. Correct path is 'artifacts/feature_sets/feature_set_registry.json'. Wrong path never exists -> registry never found -> feature audit silently skipped.
CRITICAL.impact: Feature contract not validated before Test access.

CRITICAL.root_cause: joblib artifact is a dict wrapping StandardScaler: {scaler: StandardScaler, pass_through_feature_order: [...], ...}. Wrapper loaded the dict, not the StandardScaler. transform_only() called dict.transform() -> AttributeError. StandardScaler was fitted on 28 features (scaled).
CRITICAL.impact: AttributeError on first X scaling attempt.
CRITICAL.required_fix: Extract inner StandardScaler from dict. Wrap outer dict and handle 33-feature split (28 scaled + 5 pass-through) in transform_only().

MAJOR.root_cause: runtime_features = checkpoints[42].model_config.get('feature_names', locked_features). model_config has no feature_names -> always fallback to locked_features from registry. Fixed by D-02 fix + explicit runtime_features = locked_features.
MAJOR.impact: Feature audit used fallback path (correct result, but fragile).
MAJOR.required_fix: Fix registry path (D-02) + set runtime_features = locked_features.

MAJOR.root_cause: Orchestrator writes dict keys lock_match/config_match/recipe_match/population_match/scaler_match. writers.py CSV header uses lock_hash_match/config_hash_match/recipe_hash_match/population_hash_match/scaler_ref_match. Extra dict keys silently dropped -> misaligned CSV.
MAJOR.impact: Checkpoint verification CSV has misaligned columns.
MAJOR.required_fix: Rename orchestrator dict keys to match CSV header.

defects_fixed: D-01: checkpoint_loader.py — inject input_size=LOCKED_FEATURES before validate_transformer_config
D-02: orchestrator — correct feature registry path: artifacts/feature_sets/feature_set_registry.json
D-04: orchestrator — rename CSV dict keys to match writer CSV header
D-05: scaler_loader.py — wrap outer dict, extract inner StandardScaler, handle 33-feature split in transform_only
